feynman_certification.listener_verdict: This actually slapped. You didn't waste my time with 'Today we're going to learn about' and you didn't treat me like a toddler with 'smart drawers' metaphors. The concept of weight reuse via a router/depth index is clear enough that I can visualize the architecture without needing a diagram. It feels like a real dev talking to another dev.

thriller_metadata.physical_analogy: A skyscraper where every floor is a carbon copy of the lobby, wasting massive structural space.
thriller_metadata.paradigm_shift: Recurrent weight-space merging allows one block to simulate infinite depth.
